pr_body:
Reset the workspace layout to the output's default only if the workspace
is actually attached to an output.

Fixes #5762

issue_context.title: Sway crashes when unplugging an output with only sticky, floating container
issue_context.body:
### Please fill out the following:
- **Sway Version:**
  - sway version 1.5-d06c1ac1 (Oct 24 2020, branch 'HEAD')

- **Debug Log:**
  - https://gist.github.com/mwenzkowski/cc0400d92e17bf8dd56652ee9d5e0aaa#file-debug-log

- **Configuration File:**
  - Default configuration file
 
- **Stack Trace:**
  - https://gist.github.com/mwenzkowski/cc0400d92e17bf8dd56652ee9d5e0aaa#file-stack-trace

- **Description:**
  - After starting sway on my laptop with an external monitor attached, I opened a terminal on the external monitor, made it floating and sticky and unplugged the external monitor, then sway chrashed.

I have begun investigating this issue and will prepare a patch myself.

review_comments: Can you please add to the comment above something like "If we are evacuating a workspace with only sticky floating containers, the workspace will already be detached from the output."?
